column1: **moistureNvars:** Number of moisture species *C-M if moistureSelector==1*
**moistureAdvSelectorQv:** Water vapor advection scheme selector *C-M if moistureSelector==1*
**moistureAdvSelectorQv_b:** Hybrid advection scheme parameter for water vapor *C-M if moistureSelector==1*
**moistureAdvSelectorQi:** Moisture advection scheme selector for non-qv fields (non-oscillatory schemes) *C-M if moistureSelector==1*
**moistureSGSturb:** Selector to apply sub-grid scale diffusion to moisture fields *C-M if moistureSelector==1*
**moistureCond:** Selector to apply condensation to mositure fields *C-M if moistureSelector==1*
**moistureCondTscale:** Relaxation time in seconds *C-M if moistureSelector==1*
**moistureCondBasePres:** Selector to use base pressure for microphysics *C-M if moistureSelector==1*
**moistureMPcallTscale:** Time scale for microphysics to be called *C-M if moistureSelector==1*
